name: 7 · Compost Factory
rule_text: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower.

levels.title: 7-01 · Factory Orientation
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Establish economy and cover all five lanes.
levels.joke: The welcome mat says hello, not all-you-can-eat. The safety poster says zero accidents since twelve seconds ago. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-02 · Solar Salary Negotiations
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Build sun production before doubling your shooters.
levels.joke: Sunlight remains free. The zombie subscription is harder to cancel. The foreman has optimized away the coffee break. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-03 · Welding the Wrong Helmet
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Local traffic cone promoted to middle management. The compost machine insists this is all organic. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 7-04 · Magnetic Accounting
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: The doctor recommends more brains. Seek a second opinion. The welding mask does not improve the wearer’s judgment. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 7-05 · Foreman Says Hurry
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Your delivery is three lanes away and marked delivered. The assembly line has assembled a queue of complaints. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-06 · Twenty-Two Production Units
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Win with at most 22 planting actions, including grafts and rafts.
levels.joke: Twenty plants. Infinite unsolicited gardening opinions. The safety poster says zero accidents since twelve seconds ago. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 7-07 · Root Cause Analysis
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Lose no more than 3 plants to attacks or shoveling. Single-use plants do not count. Union rules also cap you at 26 planting actions.
levels.joke: The roots have formed a union. Please keep them alive. The foreman has optimized away the coffee break. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-08 · Assembly Line Detour
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Turn signals are apparently a living-person feature. The compost machine insists this is all organic. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-09 · Emergency Power Reserve
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Hold 4500 unspent sun and clear all waves. Collection continues after the last zombie.
levels.joke: Four thousand sun in savings. Still cannot afford a garden shed. The welding mask does not improve the wearer’s judgment. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-10 · Mowers on Strike
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. No mowers. Any breach fails the mission.
levels.joke: The mowers have requested a mental-health day. The assembly line has assembled a queue of complaints. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-11 · Interns in Hard Hats
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Clear the fast waves within 380 seconds. Speed is not an excuse: lose no more than 10 plants.
levels.joke: An internship with excellent exposure and no pulse. The safety poster says zero accidents since twelve seconds ago. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-12 · Floor Closed for Maintenance
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Dark crossed tiles cannot be planted. Zombies still travel through them.
levels.joke: These tiles are reserved for a future parking lot. The foreman has optimized away the coffee break. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-13 · Scrapbot Warranty Claim
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Cover the specialist wave; avoid relying on a single front wall. Specialists bill hourly: at most 30 planting actions.
levels.joke: This wave has read the terms and conditions. You have not. The foreman has optimized away the coffee break. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-14 · Canteen Fixed Menu
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. The supplied seed menu is fixed. Supplies are borrowed even if not yet unlocked.
levels.joke: The chef insists the menu is a tactical constraint. The compost machine insists this is all organic.

levels.title: 7-15 · Graft Quality Assurance
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Create at least 2 grafts and clear the waves. Same-plant twin hybrids count too.
levels.joke: Botany: now with legally questionable welding. The assembly line has assembled a queue of complaints.

levels.title: 7-16 · Industrial Salad Cannon
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. No plants or seeds required. Click a board tile to fire a free recharging area cannon.
levels.joke: No plants today. The salad has authorized artillery. The safety poster says zero accidents since twelve seconds ago.

levels.title: 7-17 · Five Workplace Incidents
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Lose no more than 5 plants. Transformations and deliberate single-use plants are exempt.
levels.joke: Five losses are a tragedy. Six are a failed level. The welding mask does not improve the wearer’s judgment. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-18 · Some Disassembly Required
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Summoners and small runners require rear coverage, not just one front tank.
levels.joke: Fresh interns have arrived. Their onboarding is your problem. The compost machine insists this is all organic. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-19 · Lean Seed Manufacturing
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Fixed five-seed deck (graft two Pod Shooters into a Twin Pod for double fire) and a total limit of 24 planting actions.
levels.joke: The seeds were packed by a minimalist. The assembly line has assembled a queue of complaints.

levels.title: 7-20 · Night Shift Blackout
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. No sky sun. Start from the supplied savings and plant your own economy.
levels.joke: Solar power at night: accounting would like a word. The compost machine insists this is all organic.

levels.title: 7-21 · Save the Union Garden
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. No planting. A mature garden is provided. Protect it; click a damaged plant for a free 1200-HP repair every 3 seconds. Crafted tools are optional.
levels.joke: The garden is already planted. Your job description says keep it that way. The safety poster says zero accidents since twelve seconds ago.

levels.title: 7-22 · Five Thousand Solar Credits
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Collect a total of 5000 sun in this battle. Spending does not reduce this total.
levels.joke: Collect 4000 sun. Do not stare directly at the counter. The foreman has optimized away the coffee break. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-23 · Bucket ISO Certification
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Armor soaks projectiles. Save explosives for tightly grouped helmets.
levels.joke: Buckets protect brains, not fragile workplace morale. The welding mask does not improve the wearer’s judgment. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 7-24 · Mandatory Overtime
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Long mixed assault. Pace your economy: the waves never stop being polite about it.
levels.joke: The committee has decided to attack simultaneously. The welding mask does not improve the wearer’s judgment. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 7-25 · Storm Safety Audit
levels.briefing: Conveyor pulses advance one announced lane by 35 pixels. Keep rear firepower. Two giant arrivals with a rebuilding window. Counter its special ability, then clear the field.
levels.joke: The giant brought a club. The homeowners association brought a fine. The assembly line has assembled a queue of complaints. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.
